## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.7-6

- Added an SBS50 local MQTT option. Verified local reports update existing XS0B-MR and XS01-M smoke entities and XH02-M heat alarm entities. Cloud support remains enabled, and cameras are unchanged.
- Added read-only support for XS0AD-MN and XS0AE-iA smoke alarms, XC0M-MR CO alarm and concentration, XCG0A-iA separate gas and CO indicators and CO concentration, and SBS0A hub status and paired-device reports. These additions do not extend local MQTT coverage.
